checks.check: No new swelling, giving way, or limp with normal walking
Single-leg calf raises on affected side
checks.pass: At least 20 controlled reps without worsening pain
30 seconds without giving way or worsening pain
30 min easy with pain <=2/10, no altered gait, and no next-morning worsening
checks.fail: Pain >2/10, altered gait, or next-morning worsening

gates.on_pass: 32 km first planned week is permitted as a return to recently tolerated 33–34 km/week, not guaranteed safe; requires all checks to pass.
gates.on_fail: Do not attempt 26 km; stop impact running and obtain sports-physio/medical assessment for instability, swelling, or persistent symptoms.

gates.check: Arch/ankle pain during running or next morning
gates.pass: Pain <=2/10, no worsening across 24 hours, no gait change, no swelling/instability
gates.fail: Pain >=3/10 repeatedly or lasting >24–48 hours, worsening next-morning first steps, gait change, swelling or giving way
gates.on_fail: STOP planned progression and quality/long runs; seek sports-physio/clinician assessment before resuming. Acute inability to bear weight warrants prompt medical assessment.

gates.check: Consistent weekly mileage, recent long-run recovery and symptom monitoring
gates.pass: Previous 20 and 22 km long runs recovered from within 24–48 h, ankle gate remains passed, and supporting weekly mileage is tolerable
gates.fail: Persistent symptoms, unusually prolonged recovery or missed build-up
gates.on_fail: Cap Dec 20 long run at 20–22 km or less; reduce total weekly distance and reassess.

nutrition_assumptions.maintenance_estimate_kcal_day: approximately 2700–3100 at baseline, depending on actual activity; 2950 is an initial midpoint, not measured expenditure
nutrition_assumptions.weight_target_kg: approximately 78, maintain or gain very slowly
nutrition_assumptions.weekly_adjustment_rule: Use 7-day average morning weight and compare with prior 7-day average for 2 consecutive weeks. If losing >0.25 kg/week unintentionally or recovery/hunger worsens, add 150–250 kcal/day, mainly carbs. If gaining >0.25 kg/week for 2 weeks without intent, reduce 100–150 kcal/day unless high mileage/race fueling demands more. If stable within +/-0.25 kg/week and training well, keep calories. Review weekly and prioritize fueling long runs and hard sessions.
nutrition_assumptions.carbohydrate_note: Scale carbohydrate with training load and during long runs; do not force fixed daily macros if appetite and performance suggest otherwise.

plan_notes.weekly_schedule: Monday chest/triceps + recovery run; Tuesday back/biceps + optional easy run; Wednesday quality; Thursday legs + ankle/calf; Friday shoulders/forearms/core + easy run; Saturday mobility/prehab; Sunday long run. Thursday legs are 72 hours before Sunday long run, never the day before Wednesday quality or test days.
plan_notes.last_heavy_leg_session: 2027-03-11 (Thursday, Week 20), only if recovered from March 7 HM; otherwise last heavy session 2027-02-25. Weeks 21–23 are reduced-load activation, no heavy legs.
plan_notes.race_week_tuesday: 2027-03-30 Tuesday is back/biceps only, optional very light; NO legs. Thursday 2027-04-01 is light mobility/activation only.
plan_notes.pace_calibration: Paces after December 30 are provisional starting ranges. Recalculate from actual 10K result, recovery, and RPE; do not blindly force target-marathon paces.
plan_notes.week_2_rationale: Restore 32 km (5 + 7 + 6 + 14 km) because Oct 26–Nov 1's 8.01 km was a busy-schedule outlier, while Oct 12–18 and Oct 19–25 were 34.08 and 33.02 km. Gym continued. This supports a cautious return, not a guarantee of ankle safety; all ankle gates still apply.
plan_notes.plyometrics: Only introduce brief low-volume plyometrics after ankle/arch symptoms remain stable and gates pass, not before the Sunday long run. May be omitted during high-mileage weeks.
plan_notes.gym_progression: Original exercise selection and ascending fixed-repetition sets preserved. All loads null because recorded weights are top-set baselines, not prescribed loads. Compounds 1–3 RIR, lower-body compounds 2–3 RIR; isolation top sets 0–2 RIR. During taper reduce sets and avoid failure.
plan_notes.calendar_interpretation: The first scheduled week is Mon Nov 2–Sun Nov 8, 2026 (Nov 8 is Sunday). Historical Oct 26–Nov 1 is retained as Week 1 actual; Nov 2–8 remains Week 2 in this unchanged 23-week JSON structure. If the user intends Nov 8 as the literal first training day, calendar reindexing requires separate confirmation.
plan_notes.coros_export: All planned runs now contain a coros_workout specification with distance, duration, pace/RPE, nullable HR bpm targets, and ordered steps. This is a staging schema, not verified as directly importable by COROS. Structured sessions use existing steps; some cool-downs are open-ended to meet planned distance.
